content.text: Generate an image of gray tabby cat hugging an otter with an orange scarf

output.revised_prompt: A cute and whimsical scene featuring a gray tabby cat gently hugging an otter. The otter is wearing a vibrant orange scarf that adds a pop of color to the image. The background is soft and cozy, enhancing the warm and friendly atmosphere between the two animals. The cat and otter have expressive faces, showcasing their affection for one another.
